topic: Munc18-1 (STXBP1) 如何在闭合构象下充当SNARE组装模板，及其在STXBP1脑病中的单倍剂量不足机制

sources.title: Three-dimensional structure of the neuronal-Sec1-syntaxin 1a complex
sources.role_in_article: 奠基性结构证据：晶体结构显示Munc18-1包裹闭合构象Syntaxin-1，SNARE基序被'藏'起来，提出结构悖论的起点
sources.limitation: 本次仅读摘要，未核实具体晶体学界面残基细节

sources.title: Synaptic assembly of the brain in the absence of neurotransmitter secretion
sources.role_in_article: 功能证据：Munc18-1敲除小鼠神经递质分泌完全消失，但突触形态学连接正常建立，随后神经元凋亡
sources.limitation: 本次仅读摘要，未核实凋亡时间线等具体统计数据

sources.title: Munc13 mediates the transition from the closed syntaxin-Munc18 complex to the SNARE complex
sources.role_in_article: 机制证据：NMR+FRET证明Munc13 MUN结构域协同加速闭合复合物向SNARE组装能力状态转化25-240倍
sources.limitation: 体外重构体系，非活细胞环境

sources.title: Syntaxin opening by the MUN domain underlies the function of Munc13 in synaptic-vesicle priming
sources.role_in_article: 确认MUN结构域独立足以撬开Syntaxin闭合构象，是Munc13囊泡预备功能的核心执行部件

sources.title: Munc13 activates the Munc18-1/syntaxin-1 complex and enables Munc18-1 to prime SNARE assembly
sources.role_in_article: 补全Munc13双重作用：不仅打开Syntaxin，也直接激活Munc18-1本身的组装催化能力

sources.title: Munc18-1 catalyzes neuronal SNARE assembly by templating SNARE association
sources.role_in_article: 核心机制突破：单分子光镊识别'态7'模板中间体，Munc18-1 3a结构域将SNARE基序N端预先对齐，解释闭合构象悖论
sources.limitation: 体外重构，活细胞内模板态稳定性未直接验证

sources.title: Disease-linked mutations in Munc18-1 deplete synaptic Doc2
sources.role_in_article: 揭示Munc18-1的分子伴侣式稳定器功能：致病突变继发性耗竭Doc2，为表型异质性提供候选解释
sources.limitation: 未系统覆盖所有致病突变的Doc2耗竭程度

sources.title: Stxbp1/Munc18-1 haploinsufficiency impairs inhibition and mediates key neurological features of STXBP1 encephalopathy
sources.role_in_article: 疾病机制证据：两种Stxbp1杂合敲除小鼠系显示PV/SST中间神经元突触强度选择性下降，兴奋性输入不受影响，导致癫痫样表型
sources.limitation: 小鼠模型，向人类表型的外推需谨慎
